title: Gridiron Front Office college list
description: The colleges that prospects come from (D-035). The region drives scouting coverage, the tier the quality of its prospects (F-03). Enum values are case-sensitive. Unique names are checked by the game's validator. The format only grows: a field added later is optional, so older files still load (D-077).

name.description: The list's name, shown when a league is created.
